behavior: `Menu.Positioner` has one root node, also while its menu is modal: `Menu.Portal` renders the internal backdrop of a modal menu. A rule of `<style scoped>`, `v-show` and a custom directive of the consumer thus apply to the element of the positioner. `Combobox.Portal` renders the internal backdrop of a modal combobox in the same way, so `Combobox.Positioner` has one root node too. In Base UI, the positioner renders the backdrop beside its element.
